entities.summary: Le'Ron De'Mar McClain is an American former professional football player who was a fullback in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide, and was selected by the Baltimore Ravens 137th overall in the fourth round of the 2007 NFL draft.
